Privacy policy

What we collect, why we need it, and the choices you have when you visit our website or sign in with UnlikeOtherAuthenticator.

Effective and last updated: 11 October 2026

Google sign-in, explained. UnlikeOtherAuthenticator uses your Google account identifier, email address and basic profile to sign you in. Signing in does not give us access to your Gmail, Drive, Calendar or other Google account content. A product connection that requests additional access is a separate choice with its own permissions.

1. Who we are and what this covers

The website and shared sign-in service are operated by UnlikeOtherAI s.r.o., company number (IČO) 30001641, with its registered office at Pod Borováčkem 168, Myšlín, 251 64 Mnichovice, Czech Republic.

This policy covers unlikeotherai.com, enquiries sent to us, and the shared sign-in and account service UnlikeOtherAuthenticator at authentication.unlikeotherai.com (also called UnlikeOtherAI or UOA on sign-in screens).

UnlikeOtherAI s.r.o. is the controller responsible for the personal information described in this policy. Contact us at hello@unlikeotherai.com for privacy questions or to exercise your rights.

Connected products, including Nessie, may process additional information under their own notices and agreements. If your employer or another organisation manages your account, that organisation also decides how it uses your account within its workspace. This policy does not replace its privacy notice.

2. Information we collect

Website visits and enquiries

Our hosting infrastructure receives technical request information, such as your IP address, browser information, requested URL and request time, to deliver and protect the website. If you contact us, we receive the name, email address, message and project details you send. The website enquiry form opens your email application; its contents reach us when you send that email.

Sign-in and account information

When you use Google sign-in, Google supplies a unique account identifier, email address and its verification status, and basic profile information such as your name and profile picture. The permissions are openid, email and profile. Google does not give us your Google password.

Other sign-in methods, where offered, provide the identity information displayed in their permission screen. We also hold information you provide or configure in your account, including your name, avatar, preferences and authentication factors. For password sign-in, the service stores a password hash; for two-factor authentication, it stores the information needed to verify that factor.

We record account and provider identifiers, sign-in sessions, authentication events, IP addresses and browser information for account operation and security. We also hold organisation and team memberships, roles and invitations. An organisation administrator or an invitation sender may supply your email address and intended membership before you join.

If you purchase a service or act for an organisation that does, related account, billing and acceptance records may be linked to your identity. Payment and product-specific details are also governed by the notices provided in that purchase flow.

3. How and why we use information

  • Provide your account and sign-in. We use identity, profile, session and membership information to authenticate you, return you to the product you selected and apply your access permissions. The legal basis is performance of our contract with you, or our legitimate interests in providing organisation-requested access where the contract is with your organisation.
  • Keep services secure. We use technical and authentication records to investigate faults, detect abuse, protect accounts and manage access. Our legal basis is our legitimate interests in protecting users and operating reliable services.
  • Respond to you. We use enquiry and support information to answer your request and discuss work. The basis is taking steps you request before a contract, performing a contract, or our legitimate interests in responding to correspondence.
  • Meet legal obligations. We retain and use records where necessary for applicable accounting, tax or other legal requirements. We may also use relevant records for establishing, exercising or defending legal claims, based on our legitimate interests.
  • Optional permissions. Where processing relies on your consent, we explain the specific purpose when asking and you can withdraw consent. Choosing Google sign-in authorises its identity exchange; it does not authorise unrelated product integrations.

Identity and security information necessary for authentication is required to provide sign-in. If you do not provide it, we may be unable to create an account or grant access. Optional profile details and project enquiries are your choice.

Authentication and access checks automatically verify credentials, account status and permissions. They may refuse a sign-in or access request. Contact us if you believe a refusal is incorrect so it can be investigated.

4. Who receives information

We disclose information as needed for the purposes above to:

  • The product you sign into: the account identifier, relevant profile and access information it needs to recognise you and provide its service.
  • Your organisation: authorised administrators and relevant members may see profile and membership information needed to manage or collaborate in the organisation.
  • Service providers: hosting, database, email delivery, support and security providers process the information needed to operate those services for us. Google processes the sign-in exchange when you choose Google sign-in.
  • Our operators and advisers: authorised personnel and professional advisers receive information where needed to provide support, operate the service or address legal and accounting matters.
  • Authorities or other parties: where required by law, or where necessary and lawful to protect rights, investigate abuse or resolve legal claims.

A connected product's access to other services, such as messages or files, requires its own authorisation. This sign-in policy is not permission to access those contents.

5. Storage, security and retention

We use access controls and technical protections appropriate to the information and service, including encrypted transport and controls around authentication credentials. No internet service can guarantee absolute security.

Information may be processed in the United Kingdom, the European Economic Area and countries where our service providers operate. Where a transfer requires additional protection under applicable data protection law, the transfer must use a recognised adequacy decision or appropriate safeguards, such as approved contractual clauses. Contact us for the countries and safeguards relevant to your account, or a copy of applicable safeguards.

We keep account information while it is needed to provide and administer your account. Retention depends on whether the account remains active, your organisation's applicable arrangements, security and dispute-resolution needs, and legal obligations. Session and verification data have purpose-specific expiry limits. Expiring a credential does not necessarily erase associated security records.

Enquiries are kept while we respond and for relevant follow-up or contractual needs. Authentication and security records are kept as needed to investigate incidents and protect the service. Billing and legal records may need to remain after an account closes. Backup copies may persist until the relevant backup is replaced or expires.

You can request deletion at hello@unlikeotherai.com. We will assess the request, explain any information we need to retain and the reason, and address data we control. Disconnecting Google is separate from deleting your UnlikeOtherAI account or records held by a connected product.

6. Cookies, browser storage and external services

Authentication flows use cookies or browser storage where needed to maintain the sign-in flow, protect it and remember relevant preferences. Blocking necessary storage may prevent sign-in from working.

The studio homepage uses a preference cookie named uo-stickers to remember the positions of decorative stickers when you move them. It lasts up to one year. You can remove it through your browser's site-data settings. It is not needed for authentication.

The homepage loads fonts from Google Fonts. Your browser contacts Google to obtain these files, which exposes technical request information such as your IP address to Google. These privacy and terms pages use system fonts and do not load Google Fonts.

Links to other websites and the sign-in provider's own pages are subject to their own privacy notices. You can review and revoke Google's access permissions in your Google Account connections. Revocation stops future authorised access; it does not itself delete information already held by us.

7. Your privacy rights

Depending on the applicable law and circumstances, you can ask to access your information, correct it, erase it, restrict its use or receive a portable copy. You can object to processing based on legitimate interests. Where we rely on consent, you can withdraw it without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal.

Send requests to hello@unlikeotherai.com, identifying the account or enquiry concerned. Do not send passwords, verification codes or unnecessary identity documents. We may need proportionate information to verify that a request comes from you. We respond within applicable legal time limits and explain any lawful exception or extension.

You can complain to a data protection authority, including the UK Information Commissioner's Office, the Czech Office for Personal Data Protection, or the authority where you live, work or believe an infringement occurred. You do not have to contact us first.

8. Changes and contact

We update this notice when our services or practices change and show the effective date above. Where required, we will bring material changes to your attention through the service or another appropriate channel before they take effect.

For questions about this policy, your information or our handling of your data, email hello@unlikeotherai.com or write to our registered address in section 1.
